title: Operating rules
description: Naive's operating rules as a module. The default module is operations/operating-rules.json. schema/operating-rules.ts validates a module and merges a venture's operating-rules.json over the default (meta/operating-rules.json when the venture layout is structured). The membership gate reads rejection.retry. Who may edit a rejected package, what a rejecting function may do, self-fix approval, gates before a design, the Jev layer, the design-diff verb set, question routing, pattern learning and standing-rule decay are declared for later pull requests and are not enforced yet.

id.description: Module id. The framework's module is default. A venture overlay may set its own id.

version.description: Module version. The default module is 1.

rejection.description: What happens to a rejected handoff package. edit and rejector are for a later pull request that enforces parent-only edits. retry is read by the membership gate.

edit.description: Who may edit a rejected handoff package. Declared for the later parent-only edits pull request. The membership gate does not read it.

who.description: Only the package's parent node, the sender, may edit a rejected package.

role.description: The role id of that parent in this module. The default is chief-of-staff, the Naive Lead.

rejector.description: What the function that rejects a package may do. Declared for the later parent-only edits pull request. The membership gate does not read it.

may_modify.description: Whether a function bot that rejects a package may modify it. The default is false.

return_to.description: A rejecting function returns the package to its parent.

carries.description: What the return carries: the failing gate and the reason. Nothing else.

retry.description: How many times the package is retried, by whom, and who receives it next. The membership gate copies these fields onto a rejection disposition. The retry itself is not built.

retry_by.description: Who retries. The default module says lead, the Naive Lead.

retries.description: How many times that actor retries a rejected package before escalating. The default is 1.

escalate_to.description: Who receives the package after the retries. The default is founder.

self_fix.description: The Lead's self-fix proposals. Declared for a later pull request. The membership gate does not read this.

requires_founder_approval.description: Whether a self-fix proposal needs founder approval before it is applied. The default is true.

design.description: How an agent shows a design. Declared for later pull requests. The membership gate does not read this.

gates_before_founder.description: Every agent runs the gates on its draft before showing the founder a design. The default is true. A later pull request enforces it.

diff.description: The design-diff verb set. A later pull request enforces it. The membership gate does not read it.

one_kind_per_line.description: One kind per diff line. The default is true.

split_compound.description: A compound change is split into separate lines. The default is true.

move_keeps_id.description: A move that keeps the id counts as rename.

kinds.description: Create kinds. derive must name its source.
Delete kinds. merge must name its successor.

jev.description: The Jev layer. Suggested Noul thresholds, and whether a judgment blocks. Declared for a later pull request. The membership gate does not read this. schema/operating-rules.ts rejects a module whose yes is not above no.

mode.description: record-only writes the judgment and does not block. blocking is reserved until the thresholds are decided; nothing enforces it yet. The default is record-only.

yes.description: At or above this, a Noul judgment is a yes. The suggested threshold is 0.7.

no.description: At or below this, a Noul judgment is a no. The suggested threshold is 0.3.

questions.description: Question routing, pattern learning and standing-rule decay. Declared for a later pull request. The membership gate does not read this.

type.description: A question type is three parts: a verb with its kind, a noun or a scoped noun, and the function that asks.

parts.description: The three parts, in that order. verb stands for the verb and its kind.

routing.description: How a question is routed. A rule names any non-empty subset of the three parts. The most specific matching rule wins. Equally specific matches go to the founder. Not enforced yet.

match.description: A rule matches when every part it names is the question's part. It may name one, two, or all three.

specificity.description: The matching rule that names the most parts wins.

tie.description: When two matching rules name the same number of parts, the question goes to the founder.

destinations.description: A rule routes to a function agent, to the founder, or to a standing answer.

rules.description: The routing rules. The default module has none. A venture adds its own. Not enforced yet.

pattern_learning.description: When an agent may propose a standing answer rule. min_answers and wilson_lower_bound are provisional, TBD, and are not decided thresholds. Declared for a later pull request. The membership gate does not read this.

min_answers.description: The smallest number of answers before an agent may propose a standing rule. Provisional, TBD: the number in the default module is a placeholder, not a decided threshold.

wilson_lower_bound.description: The agent may propose when the Wilson lower bound of one answer's share is >= this. Provisional, TBD: the number in the default module is a placeholder, not a decided threshold.

founder_approves.description: The founder approves each proposed standing rule.

never_verb.description: Standing rules never apply to delete verbs.

pause_when.description: A standing rule pauses when the founder answers differently.

decay.description: Standing-rule decay. After a standing rule answers, the founder's next reaction is an outcome. The score is the Wilson lower bound of satisfied outcomes over the last decay_window uses. Below decay_floor the rule is suspended. decay_window and decay_floor are provisional, TBD, and are not decided thresholds. Declared for a later pull request. The membership gate does not read this.

decay_window.description: How many of the rule's latest uses the score looks at. Provisional, TBD: the number in the default module is a placeholder, not a decided threshold.

decay_floor.description: Below this Wilson lower bound the rule is suspended. Provisional, TBD: the number in the default module is a placeholder, not a decided threshold.

satisfied.description: Outcomes that count for the rule: the founder accepts the answer, or moves on.

unsatisfied.description: Outcomes that count against the rule: an override, a correction, or detected frustration or disappointment.

frustration.description: Frustration or disappointment is a recorded Jev Noul, with its probability. It counts against the rule.

below_floor.description: Below decay_floor the rule is suspended and the agent asks the founder whether to reconfigure it.

show.description: That ask shows the uses that lowered the score.

routingRule.description: One routing rule. It names any non-empty subset of verb (with kind), noun and asking function, and one destination.

id.description: Rule id, unique in the module.

verb.description: The design-diff verb. When set, kind is required and must be one of that verb's kinds.

noun.description: A noun, or a scoped noun such as name@function.

asking_function.description: The function that asks. A department id.

function.description: The function agent. Required when to is function_agent, and only then.

answer.description: The standing answer. Required when to is standing_answer, and only then.

not.description: a function agent does not carry a standing answer
the founder route names no function and no standing answer
a standing answer does not name a function agent
standing rules never apply to a delete verb
